original_observer.erroneous_assumption: A report with all requests retired must have zero immutable versions even while an enabled prefix cache still owns a checkpoint.
original_observer.correction: Require zero versions for prefix-off cases. For this N=1 prefix-on case, require the one retained version to match the one live cache entry, within the original budget; successful Session retirement remains mandatory.

functional.scope: Three finite current-candidate natural-entry packed-policy smoke cases. These are not a quality, performance, full matrix, or cache-hit/reuse claim; prefix-scheduler had no prefix hit.

source_basis.fact: PrefixCache is a function-local owner sized by resident_sessions. Completed turns publish the session checkpoint; successful real retirement resets the session head and Session. The report is printed while PrefixCache is still alive.
PrefixPayload owns SnapshotRef; publish copies that immutable snapshot into the shared directory payload.
VersionCount counts distinct live immutable versions, including explicitly retained prefixes; SnapshotRef is shared_ptr<const State>. The version is released by its original VersionRef destructor.
The finite directory owns each payload; eviction resets the payload. Its ordinary destruction also destroys retained entry payloads.
